messages:
Hana L: Quick capture from today's onboarding check-in with Solstice Labs — pasting raw notes for product triage.

Marco D: thanks Hana, any renewal flags?

Hana L: Key customer points: 
- "Search freshness": after a 15k docs import, new docs didn't appear in searches for ~4 hours; they said "we waited through our demo slot".
- "Per-team billing": they want a soft quota per project + pre-overage email/webhook.
- "Onboarding UX": document-mapper step is unclear; many users skipped selecting fields which broke pipelines.
- "Batch errors": during import they saw intermittent 502s and a handful of docs never retried.

Sofia R: Routing: freshness -> infra/serving; billing -> pricing & product; UX -> product-ux; batch errors -> eng-runtime.

Priya: Prioritization: mark freshness + UX as high for this account (demo impacted). Billing + batch retries medium.

Hana L: Customer quote: "If this remains flaky we may pause rollout" — marking account: onboarding_at_risk, renewal_watch.

ops-bot: Created CS-5240: Solstice Labs indexing freshness + import errors (https://redwood.atlassian/CS-5240)

Marco D: Action items: Marco -> attach CSV + failing queries to CS-5240; Sofia -> request ingest traces and cache invalidation logs; Priya -> weigh in at Friday product sync with suggested weights.

Hana L: I'll send customer an acknowledgement and ETA. Thanks team :thumbsup:
